from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Full solid lines of a non-background color partition repeated panels.
    row_cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    def segments(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start < cut: out.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < n: out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rb, cb = segments(h, row_cuts), segments(w, col_cuts)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    panels = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in rb for c0,c1 in cb]
    def activity(p):
        a,b,c,d=p
        return sum(v != bg and v not in {grid[a][c],} and v not in {
            grid[r][c] for r in range(a,b) if all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r])
        } for row in grid[a:b] for v in row[c:d])
    # Most populated equal-sized panel is the repeating tile.
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(v != bg for row in grid[p[0]:p[1]] for v in row[p[2]:p[3]]))
    a,b,c,d=source
    tile=[row[c:d] for row in grid[a:b]]
    if not any(v != bg for row in tile for v in row): return out
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels:
        if (r1-r0,c1-c0)!=(len(tile),len(tile[0])): continue
        if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==source: continue
        if all(v==bg for row in grid[r0:r1] for v in row[c0:c1]):
            for i,row in enumerate(tile): out[r0+i][c0:c1]=row[:]
    return out
PY
